title: trust-state-pin
description: PROPOSED (RoT-1 revision 4). One entry of trust-state-pins in the system pin directory (/etc/gov/, /Library/Application Support/gov/, %ProgramData%\gov\) or, only when the integrity predicate holds, <account-home>/.config/gov/ (24 §3.2, §3.5): an operator-provisioned anchor (TA-9 restated). valid_until is mandatory; valid_until - provisioned_at must not exceed the Trust Policy bootstrap.pin_max_validity_days, and outside [provisioned_at, valid_until] by the local clock the pin is not an anchor (PIN_OUTSIDE_VALIDITY). The anchor is satisfied only by inclusion of (state_sequence, state_digest) in the effective chain (24 §3.4). Never read from a repository or the environment.
